output.reason: [ev-53fb690413df] limits the change to the CA and SelfSigned issuers, and only when they sign with RSA keys of 3072 bits or more. The proposed exposure matches this. It requires an Issuer or ClusterIssuer with spec.ca or spec.selfSigned set. It then adds an undecidable operand for the signing key size and for whether downstream systems support SHA-384/SHA-512. Static configuration does not show either of these. Without the issuer-type operand the condition would be too broad, and without the undecidable key-size operand it would flag issuers that use smaller or non-RSA keys.
